name: BBGI Public Company Limited
summary: Headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, BBGI Public Company Limited is actively involved in the creation and supply of biofuels and related offerings across the Thai market. The company structures its business across three primary segments: Biodiesel, Ethanol, and other categories. Its product portfolio encompasses biodiesel, bioethanol, and a variety of bio-based materials. BBGI Public Company Limited functions as a subsidiary of Bangchak Corporation Public Company Limited.
